title: BSP recognizes South Cotabato as ‘outstanding’ Mindanao partner
summary: KORONADAL CITY — The provincial government of South Cotabato was among six institutions in Mindanao recognized by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) for their contributions to the central bank’s…

blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — The provincial government of South Cotabato was among six institutions in Mindanao recognized by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) for their contributions to the central bank’s programs and advocacies. The recognition was given during the 2026 Outstanding BSP Stakeholders Appreciation Ceremony held in Davao City on Monday. Aside from South Cotabato, the BSP honored East West Banking Corp.-Cagayan de Oro, Land Bank of the Philippines-Cash Operations Unit Davao, Land Bank-Cotabato Branch, Regional Development Council-Caraga, and the Bangsamoro Information Office.
